aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:725.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Position Summary: The Box Office Agent is responsible for communicating information regarding the location, event, seating options, price structures, and other details to help guests select the best event ticket option. The incumbent will process ticket orders and collects payments. Essential Functions: The Box Office Ticket Agent is responsible for communicating information regarding the location, event, seating options, price structures, and other details to help guests select the best event ticket option. The incumbent will process ticket orders and collects payments. Follow cash handling and inventory procedures to ensure security of assets and inventory. Greet customers with a positive and friendly demeanor. Assist guests by providing information, answering questions and processing requests. Provides upselling opportunities to similar events in the genre by demonstrating a strong knowledge of upcoming events. Contributes to the team dynamic by assisting coworkers, maintaining the facilities’ cleanliness and helping to develop and maintain a positive work environment. Resolve customer concerns by providing superior customer service, utilizing common practices for resolution and escalating to supervisor when needed. Required Qualifications: A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency A minimum of 0-1 years of related work experience Excellent customer service skills Must be able to work independently and in a team setting Good communication skills to effectively communicate with customers and co-workers Basic Math skills Must be responsible and professional Effective decision-making skills Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment Available to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends Pay Scale : $16.00 - 18.00 Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside his/her normal description.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:876.team: 046 - Carlsbad - Sur La Table, 1915 Calle Barcelona, Space #130, Carlsbad, CA 92009
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:876.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. The OMNI Coordinator contributes to the success of Sur La Table stores by receiving and processing inbound shipments, OMNI fulfillment, and strategies to include operations and inventory management. The Omni Coordinator is a Full Time Interim role that reports to the General Manager (GM).
responsibilities: Greets and assists customers in finding products and delivering great service; actively listens to customer issues in a calm and agreeable manner to resolve problems; actively promotes company products and services; partners with the team effectively.

Maximize the company sales growth and profitability by performing duties associated with receiving and processing shipments by the end of day, stocking products, and supporting the sales floor, as required.

Complete shipping audits on all items $100 and above; submit SIMS (Store Inventory Management System) adjustment for discrepancies; and validate quantities received by initialing on the manifest. Pallets must be received in SIMS on the day of delivery.

Monitors all OMNI channels which includes Sur La Table BOPIS (Buy Online Pickup In Store), Amazon Today, and Go Local, picks merchandise orders, and acknowledges completion in the system; accurately packs orders in accordance with packaging requirements and timelines; completes all orders in a timely manner.
Complete the packaging and shipping process for all Customer Sends.

Responsible for researching and reporting inventory shortages/overages and reports inventory adjustments in SIMS; assists with overall organization and maintenance of OMNI hold area in stock area; processes orders, pick-ups, and return transactions.
Uses Aged Order Report to audit outstanding OMNI orders and take appropriate next steps to resolve aged orders in partnership with the MOS (Mark Out of Stock).
Review SIMS Compliance to ensure that drop shipments are received as required and outstanding tasks completed.
Participates in markdowns and pricing changes.
Anticipates and solves problems by taking decisive action, in partnership with the GM.
Additional responsibilities as assigned by GM.
qualifications: Current Sur La Table core associate | Minimum 1-2 years
Good communicator with the ability to utilize technology effectively and engage with team and customers to meet goals.
Solves problems and makes smart decisions that drive sales, profit, and best in center; executes work effectively and efficiently.
Ability to deliver and achieve results; adapts quickly to changing situations with energy and a positive attitude; organized with strong time management skills.
Able to handle customer interactions and potential issues/concerns courteously and professionally.

Available to work a flexible schedule to perform OMNI fulfillment, receiving and processing truck, and stock tasks, including weekends and holidays, early morning, or late-night shifts (will vary by location).
This position is an interim role during the holiday season from October 15, 2023 – February 17, 2024,the exact length of this role will be determined based on the business needs.

emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:8438fa3b-258d-4d.title: Senior Product Designer
emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:8438fa3b-258d-4d.description: ABOUT ALCHEMY Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences. Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com http://alchemy.com. About The Role As a Product Designer you'll sit at the intersection of product design, product thinking, and front-end engineering—someone who can take early, ambiguous ideas and turn them into interactive, evaluable experiences fast, helping teams make better decisions sooner. This role is front-end and systems-heavy, with a strong balance of hands-on building and product design partnership. You’ll help us scale and evolve Alchemy’s UI system—owning core components, patterns, and implementation quality—while also jumping into product work when needed to unblock teams and raise the craft bar. This is a high-leverage role: you’ll reduce handoff friction, increase prototype velocity, and elevate UI quality through hands-on building, close collaboration, and a strong point of view on systems. What You'll Do - Build production-quality prototypes (and, when appropriate, ship production front-end code) to validate UX direction quickly—often on tight timelines. - Own and evolve Alchemy’s design system in practice: build and maintain reusable components, patterns, and interaction primitives that scale across products. - Translate design intent into high-quality React/TypeScript UI, with attention to spacing, hierarchy, motion, and interaction polish. - Drive system scalability: identify gaps, propose improvements, and ship additions that make the product ecosystem more consistent and faster to build. - Partner closely with product designers to improve the craft and feasibility of design work—bringing an engineer’s pragmatism and a designer’s taste. - Collaborate tightly with product engineers to reduce rework and make the path from prototype → implementation smoother. - Improve “how we build UI” muscle across teams: documentation, examples, and workflow improvements that raise the baseline. - Build for an AI-native product future: create interaction patterns and UI foundations that support rapid experimentation and iteration in AI-driven experiences. - Contribute to design-system adoption and quality: tokens/components/docs, accessibility standards, and tooling (e.g., Storybook) when needed. - Help teams iterate in short cycles (e.g., ~5–10 day “idea → prototype → decision” loops), bringing clarity to what’s possible and what’s worth building. What We're Looking For - Strong front-end fundamentals and comfort building interactive UI (e.g., React + TypeScript; equivalent stacks welcome). - Systems-minded builder: you’ve shipped and maintained component libraries / design systems (tokens, components, documentation, adoption). - A designer’s eye: you care about hierarchy, spacing, typography, interaction details, and visual polish. - Proven ability to prototype quickly without sacrificing craft—and to choose the right fidelity for the question at hand. - Ability to operate in ambiguity and move fast with high ownership. - Clear communicator across disciplines; you can translate between design intent and technical constraints. - Bonus: accessibility fluency, Storybook (or similar), motion/animation experience, and experience scaling design systems across multiple product surfaces. Benefits and Perks 🩺 Medical, Dental, & Vision 💪 Gym Reimbursement 🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget 🥙 In-Office Group Meals 🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks 📚 Learning & Development Stipen

jobgether-jobgether:lever:093cbcdf-9ac2-.title: Records Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:093cbcdf-9ac2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Records Manager based in Canada. This is a flexible, fractional opportunity for an experienced records, compliance, or information governance professional to establish and manage a controlled archive and knowledge-review system. You will play a critical role in determining what information should be preserved, how records are tracked, and what material is ready for entry into a governed knowledge environment. The role combines meticulous records management with responsible use of approved AI tools to accelerate classification and inventory processes. Your judgment will remain central, with every significant AI-assisted decision requiring human verification and careful review. You will work independently, identify risks early, and ensure sensitive information is handled with exceptional discretion. This position is particularly suited to someone who values accuracy, accountability, and strong information governance practices. The engagement is structured as an 8-week pilot with up to 8 hours per week, offering meaningful work without a full-time commitment. Receive, preserve, organize, and track the custody of authorized records and source files throughout the review and archival process. Review incoming information for sensitivity, ownership, completeness, and eligibility for admission into the governed knowledge environment. Use approved AI tools to accelerate information inventory, classification, and review while personally validating all material decisions before they are finalized. Identify and immediately escalate missing, corrupted, incomplete, sensitive, or otherwise high-risk records. Maintain accurate tracking of records, review decisions, outstanding items, and relevant risks. Apply sound professional judgment when determining whether information is suitable for preservation or further review. Provide a concise weekly report covering completed work, remaining backlog, key decisions, and identified risks. Help establish reliable processes and controls for a new or evolving records and knowledge-governance function. Escalate uncertainty or ambiguity rather than making unsupported assumptions, ensuring information is handled consistently and responsibly. Requirements Professional experience in records management, information governance, compliance, audit, legal operations, or a closely related field. Exceptional discretion and demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential or sensitive information responsibly. Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy, documentation, and records integrity. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and capable of identifying errors, limitations, or inappropriate recommendations produced by AI. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions, summarize findings, and communicate risks clearly. Sound judgment and a disciplined approach to escalating uncertainty, inconsistencies, and potential compliance concerns. Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities effectively within a limited-hours engagement. Experience establishing an archive, records-management process, or governance function from the ground up is a plus. Familiarity with legal holds, privacy requirements, cybersecurity practices, or related information governance controls is advantageous. Experience designing human-review controls or quality-assurance processes for AI-assisted workflows is a bonus. A mindset focused on accountability, precision, and preventing unverified information from becoming part of an official knowledge environment. Benefits Fractional contract engagement of up to 8 hours per week. 8-week pilot engagement. Flexible work-from-anywhere arrangement. HMO health insurance. Paid time off. Opportunities for promotion. Potential for pay increases. Opportunity to contribute to the development of a new records and knowledg

jobgether-jobgether:lever:134e2ba5-372c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr UI/UX Designer based in Canada. As a Sr UI/UX Designer, you will shape intuitive, engaging digital experiences for products serving the iGaming industry. You will own key aspects of the design process, from user research and concept development to prototyping, testing, and refinement. The role combines creative thinking with data-driven decision-making to deliver experiences that are both visually compelling and highly usable. You will work closely with product and development teams to transform business requirements into effective digital solutions. Your expertise will help improve customer journeys, strengthen product experiences, and support innovative design initiatives. This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative, fast-moving environment while continuously expanding your UI/UX expertise. Design intuitive, engaging, and user-centered interfaces that align with client brand identities and product objectives within the iGaming sector. Research user behaviors, preferences, and needs to inform design decisions and create meaningful user experiences. Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional and visually compelling designs. Develop wireframes, prototypes, mockups, and other design deliverables to communicate concepts effectively and support product development. Conduct usability testing, gather user and stakeholder feedback, and continuously iterate on designs to improve usability and overall experience. Apply data-driven insights from analytics, experimentation, and user research to identify opportunities for product and UX improvements. Monitor emerging UI/UX trends, design practices, technologies, and developments across the iGaming industry to introduce innovative solutions. Requirements Degree or equivalent academic background in IT, UI/UX Design, or a related discipline is preferred. At least 3 years of professional experience in UI/UX design, with a strong understanding of UX principles and user-centered design methodologies. Demonstrated experience designing digital products for the iGaming industry, with an in-depth understanding of its users and product environment. Strong proficiency with design and collaboration tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, and Miro, as well as prototyping tools such as Origami Studio, Noodl, Framer, Proto.io, or UXPin. Experience applying data-driven design practices using tools and methods such as Google Analytics, A/B testing, and Hotjar. Experience conducting and interpreting both qualitative and quantitative user research. Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud tools, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects. Communicate effectively within a fully remote team and maintain strong alignment across development activities. Remain adaptable and, when required, contribute to other products within the wider SaaS portfolio. Proven experience working in SaaS environments and delivering production-grade web applications. Collaborative mindset and ability to work closely with front-end developers and other technical stakeholders. Strong remote communication skills and ability to work effectively within a distributed team. Proactive approach, with a willingness to challenge assumptions and suggest technical or product improvements. Fluent French is essential, as it is the team's primary working language. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? As an Usher at the Chicago Theatre, you will provide positive guest/client experiences at live events. An Usher is responsible for greeting the guest, directional assistance through various entry/departure points, line management, assisting with emergency or medical situations, and answering frequent questions regarding the event or the Chicago Theatre. What will you do? As an Usher at the Chicago Theatre, you will promote positive guest/client experiences during the beginning (ingress), middle of event and show departure (egress). Welcome guests to The Chicago Theatre and provide wayfinding assistance. Check aisles, rows, and seats prior to the house opening to ensure cleanliness. Notify Supervisor of any issues prior to opening. Check designated area to be sure all emergency exit pathways are clear and accessible prior to opening. Notify Supervisor prior to opening with any concerns. Scan patrons’ tickets and report any invalid tickets to a Supervisor. Support lobby activities and ancillary activations including but not limited to VIP packages, soundchecks, and meet and greets. Guide patrons to their seats efficiently and answer guest questions. Assist third party vendors with any necessary set-up prior to ingress. Turn in any Lost and Found items to the Supervisor immediately. Communicate any building deficiencies, security concerns, or safety issues to a Supervisor. Ensure event specific details and policies are adhered to by guests. Be prepared to take an active role in Emergency Operations procedures (evacuation plan) through on-going training and drills. Aid other departments as needed. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? Previous Usher, Ticket Taker, or Guest Relations experience preferred. Strong communication and customer service skills. Ability to work with large crowds. Must be able to tolerate and work in a loud, fast paced environment. General computer proficiency and email communications are required. Maintain a professional manner, presence, and appearance always while on premises/duty. All candidates must be available to work 75% of the monthly show schedule (No guarantee of minimum hours). Must be comfortable with heights (working on high floor) and navigating steep steps and inclines. Must be willing to rotate to various positions within a shift. Special Requirements Must be receptive to working outside in inclement weather and extreme temperatures. Must be comfortable operating a limited mobility lift. Must be comfortable with heights. Must be knowledgeable to use a handheld PDA. Ability to carry, lift, push, pull up to 30 lbs; Must be able to traverse steps and be able to walk and stand long periods of time Must be able to work within an environment with loud noises and everchanging visuals. Must be willing to rotate to various posts within a shift as needed, based on business need. Ability to stand and move about the theater throughout the duration of the shift.
